adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly introduces/keeps multiple “empty” states for `destinationCalendar`: in `handleNewBooking.ts` the event sets `destinationCalendar` to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exist (`... : null`), while many other call sites set it to `[]` (e.g., bookingReminder, webhooks, confirm/editLocation/deleteCredential handlers). The type definitions also allow `destinationCalendar?: DestinationCalendar[] | null` (so `undefined` is also possible). This inconsistency forces consumers to handle `undefined | null | []` and leads to mixed patterns in the diff (`?? []` vs `&& length > 0`), so the review comment to pick/enforce a canonical empty representation is valid and diff-grounded.
